name: AOKI Holdings Inc.
summary: AOKI Holdings Inc. engages in the fashion, anniversary and bridal, entertainment, and real estate rental businesses in Japan. The company operates through Fashion Business, Entertainment Business, and Anniversaire and Bridal Business segments. It creates and sells clothing for men, women, fashion accessories, and other apparel, as well as business and business casual styling under the AOKI and ORIHICA brand names; and operates apparel store that offers casual clothing of big sizes for men and women under the Size MAX name.
